direct_evidence.observation: ce00787 explicitly removes the entire writer module, the ui/overlay desktop interface, overlay icons, desktop shortcuts and overlay systemd service, and states that the Web UI becomes the single Frank interaction entry point.

The base revision implements a three-tier router over Qwen2.5-3B, Llama 8B and DeepSeek-R1; the head revision implements a single-model Qwen2.5-3B router on port 8105 while keeping the public route/stream/ingest API surface.
The base modeld has a DeepSeek backend at 8101; the head modeld retains the service skeleton but BACKENDS is empty.

The persistent consciousness daemon remains present across the commit with its workspace persistence, mood trajectories, attention, predictions, consolidation, perception, experience vectors and goal/reflection loops; changed comments/token assumptions align background cognition with the smaller model regime rather than deleting those loops.

The deleted overlay code contained WebUI-to-Overlay chat synchronization, proving WebUI and Overlay coexisted before ce00787; the commit consolidates interfaces rather than introducing WebUI from nothing.

findings.statement: ce00787 is a coupled simplification event: desktop interface/writer surfaces are removed while the inference router is collapsed to a single Qwen2.5-3B backend.
findings.falsifier: A source at the exact head showing retained active overlay/writer execution or a retained multi-tier router/modeld backend would falsify this reading.

findings.statement: The commit changes presentation and inference topology more strongly than the persistent cognitive-state topology: the consciousness daemon survives while interface and model-selection complexity are reduced.
findings.falsifier: A broader exact semantic diff showing removal/disablement of the daemon's persistent loops or migration of those loops into the deleted interface would overturn this inference.

findings.statement: WebUI centralization is consolidation of an already coexisting interface, not creation of the WebUI boundary at ce00787.
findings.falsifier: Evidence that the referenced WebUI sync code was dead/generated and no WebUI runtime existed before the commit would weaken this conclusion.

findings.statement: Commit-title/path-family assimilation alone is insufficient for semantic lineage: the same commit contains an under-described model-routing/backend collapse outside the headline overlay/writer deletion.
findings.falsifier: A complete commit metadata source that explicitly enumerated the router/modeld semantic collapse would remove this specific under-description example but not the general need for semantic code reads.

branch_feedback.delta: Historical evidence supports treating interface topology, model routing topology and persistent cognitive-state loops as separable architecture axes; ce00787 simplifies the first two without deleting the third.

Historical persistence of the consciousness/workspace daemon across UI and model-router simplification is relevant lineage evidence, but is not causal evidence that the GWT-like mechanism was functionally preserved; lesion/rescue evidence remains required.
Level-0 method guard: exact path identities must be paired with semantic reads of high-impact modified runtime files because commit descriptions can under-specify coupled architecture changes.

credit.reason: Bounded semantic lineage shard; Project-Frankenstein global exact tree/history denominator is not yet certified complete.
